from pathlib import Path
prog_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486302/attempts/db4e56d7e3694d8caea4d8353ff4c479/system/state/workspace/programs')
prog_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    """Copy the matching horizontal template run along each isolated marker row."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    templates = []
    template_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != 0:
                c += 1
            if c - start > 1:
                seq = row[start:c]
                templates.append(seq)
                template_cells.update((r, x) for x in range(start, c))

    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, color in enumerate(row):
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in template_cells:
                continue
            matches = [seq for seq in templates if color in seq]
            if not matches:
                continue
            seq = matches[0]
            anchor = seq.index(color)
            start = c - anchor
            for i, value in enumerate(seq):
                x = start + i
                if 0 <= x < w:
                    out[r][x] = value
    return out
'''
path=prog_dir/'task-cd9c2046.py'
path.write_text(program)
print(path)
